name: Great Waves
source:
"Captain disappeared by the curse of the sea."

After his father disappeared, Trey decided to go on a journey along with his friend and his father's former pirate crew members to find the truth underneath the waves.

[From [url=https://kenjilo.itch.io/great-waves]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“船长因大海的诅咒而消失了。”

父亲失踪后，特雷决定与朋友以及父亲的前海盗船员一起踏上旅程，寻找海底的真相。
